name: The Mad Inspector
summary:
Welcome to The Mad Inspector, a chaotic VR inspection game where every person could be hiding something unexpected!
- Inspect suspicious characters and search them for hidden items.
- Decide who gets approved and who gets rejected.
- Confiscate illegal, valuable, strange, and hilarious objects.
- Sell seized items and build up your cash.
- Upgrade your headquarters with new equipment and areas.
- Unlock weapons and prepare yourself for dangerous situations.
